# Sphere

> Sphere is an Australian enterprise drone solutions provider. We design, integrate, and operate autonomous and Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS)-ready drone systems for industry, infrastructure, and government, pairing Australian-built platforms (HubX, HubT, and the Curo software suite) with global hardware and software. We are an established aviation operator holding CASA ReOC #1114, Broad Area BVLOS Approval, and ROC approval, with experience delivering complex SORA assessments.

Legal entity: Sphere Communications Pty Ltd (ABN 61 003 102 663). Headquartered in Sydney, with an office in Perth and operational presence across Queensland and Victoria. Remote operations run from a Sydney-based Remote Operations Centre (ROC) staffed by certified Remote Pilots. Core sectors: mining and resources, utilities, energy and renewables, construction and transport, government and public safety. Accreditations include BARS certification, AAUS Platinum Membership, and CASA Know Your Drone Safety Advocate. The brand name in all copy is "Sphere" (also searched as Sphere Drones, Sphere Drones Australia, Sphere Australia). First-party platform pricing (HubX, HubT, Curo) is provided per project; third-party hardware pricing is listed on individual product pages. Contact: 1800 119 111, info@spheredrones.com.au.

Last updated: June 2026.

## First-party platforms: hardware
- [HubX](https://www.spheredrones.com.au/products/hubx): Turnkey, configurable, and portable Drone-in-a-Box platform for autonomous and BVLOS-ready operations. Deploys anywhere with no fixed infrastructure, running on retractable solar with battery backup, Starlink and 5G connectivity, climate-controlled compartments, a GNSS base station, and edge compute. The modular payload bay supports DJI Dock 2, DJI Dock 3, Riegl VZ-2000i, dual docks, or a bring-your-own payload. The WatchTower sensor stack adds ADS-B, airband (VHF) radio, 360 and PTZ cameras, floodlights, and weather and lightning monitoring. Available self-managed or with Sphere Managed Services. Engineered and manufactured in Australia (assembled at Sydney HQ); patented.
- [HubT](https://www.spheredrones.com.au/products/hubt): Plug-and-play remote data capture platform built for permanent deployment on existing infrastructure. Available in trailer or skid configurations and supports up to two DJI Dock 3 units per system. Includes the WatchTower sensor stack and air-conditioned power and data compartments, integrates with existing site power and network (LTE or satellite), and is managed through the Curo software suite. Available self-managed or with Sphere Managed Services. Engineered and manufactured in Australia; patented.

## First-party platforms: Curo software suite
- [CuroRPA](https://www.spheredrones.com.au/products/curo-rpa): Enterprise drone compliance. Audit-ready records, built-in credential enforcement, and alignment with CASA requirements.
- [CuroROC](https://www.spheredrones.com.au/products/curo-roc): Enterprise live drone operations. Run compliant remote and BVLOS operations from anywhere, with full situational awareness and compliance enforcement.
- [CuroInsights](https://www.spheredrones.com.au/products/curo-insights): Drone data processing and insights, part of the Curo software suite.

## Choosing between HubX and HubT
HubT suits permanent, fixed-site deployments that use existing infrastructure and customer-supplied power. HubX suits portable, off-grid operations where no infrastructure is available, supplying its own solar power, connectivity, and a relocatable trailer.
